idea-plugin.name: OXID Buddy
idea-plugin.description:
Helpers for OXID eShop development.
  • Translation key completion in [{oxmultilang ident="..."}] and Language::translateString('...'). Each suggestion shows the translated text and where the key is defined: module, theme or core, the language, and frontend or admin.
  • Compare Translations With… on a language file: compares it key by key with the same file in another language. Add missing keys, remove keys, or jump to a key in its file.

Requires the bundled PHP and Smarty plugins. For completion in templates, set the Smarty delimiters of the project to [{ and }].

This plugin is AI-coded: the code was written by an AI model (Claude) working from a human developer's instructions.

Source code and documentation · Issue tracker

Independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by OXID eSales AG or JetBrains.
